<script lang="ts">
import type { Review, ReviewLabels } from "./review-list.types";

export type ReviewListProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  reviews: Review[];
  labels: ReviewLabels;
  layout?: "list" | "grid";
  item?: "card" | "plain";
  avatar?: "none" | "image";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "roomy";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import Rating from "../components/rating.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  reviews,
  labels,
  layout = "list",
  item = "card",
  avatar = "none",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<ReviewListProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :measure="(((layout as string) === 'list') ? '2xl' : 'default')"
  >
    <Grid :cols="(((layout as string) === 'grid') ? '1-3' : '1')" class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      <Block v-for="r in reviews" :key="r.id"
        tag="article"
        :class="cn(
          'flex h-full flex-col gap-4',
          (
            (item as string) === 'card' ? 'rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border'
            : 'border-b border-border pb-4'
          )
        )"
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <Rating :value="r.rating" :label="tpl(labels.ratingLabel, r.rating)" :size="16" />
        <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="bold">
          {{ r.title }}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ r.text }}
        </Text>
        <Group gap="4" align="center" class="mt-auto">
          <MediaFrame
            v-if="((avatar as string) === 'image')"
            :alt="r.author"
            ratio="1/1"
            class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full"
          />
          <Stack gap="0">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ r.author }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ r.date }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Group>
      </Block>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
